Upgrade your server or workstation with the Intel X520DA1 PCIe x4 Single-Port 10G SFP+ Fiber-Optic NIC for ultra-fast, reliable 10Gbps network connectivity. Ideal for virtualization, storage networks, and high-performance computing.

The Intel X520DA1 PCIe x4 Single-Port 10G SFP+ Fiber-Optic Server NIC delivers high-performance 10Gbps network connectivity for servers and workstations. Powered by the Intel 82599 controller, this single-port SFP+ adapter supports virtualization offloads like VT-c, SR-IOV, and VMDq for optimized server performance.

Compatible with a wide range of operating systems, including Windows, Linux, and FreeBSD, the X520DA1 supports fiber-optic and direct attach copper (DAC) connections, making it perfect for high-speed data centers, enterprise networks, and homelab setups. Upgrade your network infrastructure with reliable 10Gbps performance and low latency with Intel’s trusted network technology.


Key Features:


  • Model: OT-ST7315
  • Single 10G SFP+ port for ultra-fast network speeds
  • PCIe x4 interface, backward compatible with PCIe x8/16 slots
  • Intel 82599 chipset with advanced virtualization support
  • Compatible with fiber-optic and DAC cables
  • OS support: Windows, Linux, FreeBSD
  • Ideal for virtualization, storage, and high-performance computing
